Class S3OutputFile

java.lang.Object
dev.hardwood.AbstractOutputFile
dev.hardwood.s3.S3OutputFile
All Implemented Interfaces:
OutputFile, Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class S3OutputFile extends AbstractOutputFile

An OutputFile that writes one S3 object, created by S3Source.outputFile(String, String).

The object is sent as a multipart upload, or in a single PUT when it is smaller than one part, and appears at its key only once AbstractOutputFile.close() succeeds. AbstractOutputFile.discard() aborts the upload. See S3Source.outputFile(String, String) for buffering, size limits and failure handling.

    • doDiscard

      protected void doDiscard() throws IOException

      Waits for the part uploads in flight to end and aborts the multipart upload, if one was started.

      The wait and the abort run with the thread's interrupt status cleared, and the status restored afterwards, so that an interrupted writer still releases its parts.

      Overrides:
      doDiscard in class AbstractOutputFile
      Throws:
      IOException - if the resources cannot be released
